name: MUSI 3979
title: Junior Half Recital
description: Students will perform a 30-minute junior recital in preparation for their senior recital (MUSI 4979). Students must be enrolled in MUSI 3222. Required of all Bachelor of Music performance majors.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher; students must pass a promotional jury at end of sophomore year; instructor consent. Corequisite: MUSI 3222. Recommended preparation: Consultation with applied instructor.
